scope: Secondary learning-rate sensitivity and paper-style best-of-grid reproduction; original fixed-setting protocol is not overwritten
trigger: The first primary BERT-none run completed after a compiler workaround but had F1=0, recall=0 and balanced training loss near 0.693
registered_before: All additional learning-rate trials, and before any Laya test evaluation
architectures: All eight Table III UNSW configurations, not selectively BERT
checkpoint: Final checkpoint from original training-loss stopping rule
selection: Report each learning rate and each repeat, plus best held-out F1 across rates/repeats as the paper does; explicitly test-selected and optimistic
laya: One preselected fine-tuning rate, 0.00001, three repeats. Full five-rate Laya search is not performed; tuning effort is asymmetric and no optimal-Laya claim is permitted
numerical_divergence: Preserve failure and mark missing performance, never impute zero. Other execution errors halt the grid for inspection
interpretation: Cannot attribute non-convergence to architecture alone. A best-of-grid comparison is descriptive, not independent validation or proof of zero-day detection
